# NetworkConfig

`jaff.core.network.config.NetworkConfig`

<!-- Generated by `python -m jaff._utils.api_docs`; do not edit. -->

Network (`[network]`).

## Attributes

| Attribute | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `str or None` | Human-readable network name; without it, the network file stem. |
| `strict` | `bool` | Treat validation problems (conservation, sinks/sources, ...) as fatal. |
| `funcfile` | `bool or Path` | `.jfunc` auxiliary file: `true` looks next to the network file, `false` loads none, a path names it. |
| `expand_nuclei` | `bool` | Expand `n_<element>_nuc` into the element-nucleus sum. |
| `reactions` | `ReactionsConfig` | Settings of the reactions. |
| `radiation` | `RadiationConfig or None` | Radiation field; the table enables radiation. |
| `dust` | `DustConfig or None` | Dust; the table enables the dust module. |
| `thermodynamics` | `ThermodynamicsConfig` | Thermodynamics. |
